text:
Maya: FYI discovered a subtle onboarding bug in samples/quickstart: when the model is overloaded the API returns 503 with body `{'error': 'temporary'}` and the sample UI shows a raw error toast "500/503". Users are confused and retry spamming.

Priya: oof. Do we have a canonical machine-readable retry signal? right now infra only emits Retry-After header sometimes.

Arjun: short answer: not consistently. We have Retry-After for rate limits, but model serve transient errors rarely include it. That means SDKs can't uniformly decide backoff windows.

Elaine: Proposal: add small canonical fields in the error JSON: `code` (string), `retryable` (bool), `retry_after` (seconds, optional), and `operation_id` (opaque string). Example: `{\n  "error": { "code": "model_overloaded", "message": "node overloaded", "retryable": true, "retry_after": 10, "operation_id": "op_00a1" }\n}`
This lets SDKs and sample apps do three things: 1) show a friendly message + countdown 2) auto-surface retry button with suggested wait time 3) attach operation_id to logs so SRE can trace the event.

Sam: i like operation_id a lot. Also want to call out idempotency: for non-idempotent ops (streaming, edit) SDKs shouldn’t auto-retry even if `retryable=true` unless the client set an idempotency token. We should expose `idempotency_supported`: true/false per endpoint in our OpenAPI or model catalog.

Arjun: good catch. Let's add an `idempotency` field in the API docs and make the SDK error type include `is_safe_to_retry()` which checks both `retryable` and client-provided idempotency token. Default: do NOT retry automatically for non-idempotent endpoints.

Priya: for UX, sampleapp should render a short hint like: "Try again in ~10s or click \"Retry now\" to requeue (safe for idempotent requests)." and put the operation_id in the debug link. Also log the full error into Sentry with tags {operation_id, code}.

Maya: one more nuance: 429 (quota) vs 503 (overload) vs 5xx (internal). We should categorize default behaviors in a tiny matrix in onboarding:
- 4xx (except 429/422): client error -> no retry
- 422: validation -> surface field errors, no retry
- 429: rate limit -> honor Retry-After if present, otherwise exponential backoff
- 5xx/503/model_overloaded: transient -> retryable=true by default, but SDKs defer to endpoint idempotency

Elaine: agreed. Action items:
1) API: standardize error JSON with fields `code`, `message`, `retryable`, `retry_after?`, `operation_id?` (infra + api-design)
2) Docs: add status/code -> behavior matrix and update OpenAPI to include `idempotency` metadata for endpoints (api-docs)
3) SDKs: implement TypedError with `.code`, `.retryable`, `.retry_after`, `.operation_id`, and helper `client.with_retries()` that respects idempotency token. Default: no auto-retries for non-idempotent endpoints. (Sam + Priya take Python/JS parity)
4) Samples: quickstart UI: show human-friendly hint, retry button with countdown, and debug link that includes operation_id (Maya to patch)
5) Observability: Sentry/metrics should tag `operation_id` and `error.code` (infra/sre)

Sam: i'll open a parity ticket for Python + JS SDKs. Will include interface examples: `try: client.generate(...)
except RedwoodAPIError as e:
    if e.retryable and client.is_idempotent('generate'):
        # show retry UI or call client.with_retries().generate()
`

Arjun: i'll open the API RFC and ping infra + api-design. We should land a minimal change (error fields only) behind a feature flag first so we can roll without breaking older SDKs.

CI-bot: Maya/error-retry-ui branch smoke tests queued after PR push.

Priya: one tiny ask: include a short `user_facing_hint` vs `debug_hint` distinction. We don't want to dump internal troubleshooting text into UIs. `user_facing_hint` should be 1-2 sentences max.

Elaine: good call. Add that to the API shape.

Maya: thanks all. i'll send the sampleapp patch and a screenshot of the retry UI. will link RFC once Arjun drafts it.
